title: Schedule a long-haul flight
why: Shows that a multi-day long-haul flight is accepted when dates span days, and how the small duration/price limits interact.

steps.does: POST …/flight with FlightNumber FL-2200, JFK to LHR, DurationMinutes 50, Price 9, Status Flying, DepartureDate 2026-11-12T22:00, ArriveDate 2026-11-13T10:00, FlightDate 2026-11-12

expect: Success: flight created with arrival on the following day; values 50 and 9 are within the stated maximums.
